theory Functions

Functions

Combinators, products, coproducts, extensionality, universes, intersection.

Categorical combinators, products, coproducts, and function rules of CTT.

This theory formalizes: 1. Combinators and the category of types and functions: composition, identity, associativity, and left/right identity neutrality. 2. Function extensionality (`fun_ext`), η-conversion (`fun_eta`), and application congruence (`app_cong`). 3. Universal properties of categorical products (`Fork`, projections) and coproducts (`Case`, injections). 4. Currying adjunction and roundtrip isomorphism between `A × B → C` and `A → B → C`. 5. Dependent functions, dependent pairs (Σ-types), and intersection types.

33 theorems, 11 abstractions, checked by replaying their tactic scripts on the kernel. Hover any piece of syntax for its kind, surface form, and uniform term; open Tactics, Proof, or Analysis to go deeper.

-- | Categorical combinators, products, coproducts, and function rules of CTT.
--
-- This theory formalizes:
-- 1. Combinators and the category of types and functions: composition, identity,
--    associativity, and left/right identity neutrality.
-- 2. Function extensionality (`fun_ext`), η-conversion (`fun_eta`), and
--    application congruence (`app_cong`).
-- 3. Universal properties of categorical products (`Fork`, projections) and
--    coproducts (`Case`, injections).
-- 4. Currying adjunction and roundtrip isomorphism between `A × B → C` and
--    `A → B → C`.
-- 5. Dependent functions, dependent pairs (Σ-types), and intersection types.
theory Functions

abs Id == λx. x
abs Compose(f; g) == λx. f (g x)
abs K == λx. λy. x
abs S == λf. λg. λx. (f x) (g x)
abs Flip == λf. λx. λy. f y x
abs Fst(p) == let <u, v> = p in u
abs Snd(p) == let <u, v> = p in v
abs Fork(f; g) == λx. <f x, g x>
abs Case(f; g) == λd. decide d of inl u => f u | inr v => g v
abs Curry(f) == λx. λy. f <x, y>
abs Uncurry(f) == λp. let <u, v> = p in f u v

soft Id, Compose, K, S, Flip, Fst, Snd, Fork, Case, Curry, Uncurry

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Combinators and category laws
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

theorem identity :
  ∀A:U{i}. A → A
proof
  intro A
  intro x
  hyp
qed

theorem const :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. A → B → A
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro x
  intro y
  hyp 3
qed

theorem subst_comb :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ∀C:U{i}.
    (A → B → C) → (A → B) → A → C
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro C
  intro f
  intro g
  intro x
  elim 5 with x THENL [
    hyp,
    elim 4 with x THENL [hyp, elim 8 with y THENL [hyp, hyp]]
  ]
qed

theorem apply :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. (A → B) → A → B
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro f
  intro x
  elim 3 with x THENL [hyp, hyp]
qed

theorem compose :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ∀C:U{i}. (B → C) → (A → B) → A → C
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro C
  intro f
  intro g
  intro x
  elim 5 with x THENL [hyp, elim 4 with y THENL [hyp, hyp]]
qed

theorem flip :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ∀C:U{i}. (A → B → C) → B → A → C
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro C
  intro f
  intro y
  intro x
  elim 4 with x THENL [hyp, elim 7 with y THENL [hyp, hyp]]
qed

-- Category laws: associativity of composition
theorem compose_assoc :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ∀C:U{i}. ∀D:U{i}.
  ∀f:(A → B). ∀g:(B → C). ∀h:(C → D). ∀x:A.
    Compose(h; Compose(g; f)) x = Compose(Compose(h; g); f) x ∈ D
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro C
  intro D
  intro f
  intro g
  intro h
  intro x
  auto
qed

-- Category laws: identity is left-neutral
theorem compose_id_left :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ∀f:(A → B). ∀x:A.
    Compose(Id; f) x = f x ∈ B
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro f
  intro x
  auto
qed

-- Category laws: identity is right-neutral
theorem compose_id_right :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ∀f:(A → B). ∀x:A.
    Compose(f; Id) x = f x ∈ B
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro f
  intro x
  auto
qed

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Extensionality, η, and congruence
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

theorem fun_ext :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ∀f:(A → B). ∀g:(A → B).
    (∀x:A. f x = g x ∈ B) → f = g ∈ (A → B)
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro f
  intro g
  intro ext
  eq
  elim 5 with x THENL [hyp, hyp]
qed

theorem fun_eta :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ∀f:(A → B). (λx. f x) = f ∈ (A → B)
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro f
  eq THEN auto
qed

theorem app_cong :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ∀f:(A → B). ∀g:(A → B). ∀x:A. ∀y:A.
    (f = g ∈ (A → B)) → (x = y ∈ A) → f x = g y ∈ B
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro f
  intro g
  intro x
  intro y
  intro pf
  intro pxy
  elim 7 THEN elim 8 THEN auto
qed

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Products, pairing, and universal property
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

theorem pair_intro :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. A → B → A × B
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro x
  intro y
  split THENL [hyp 3, hyp 4]
qed

theorem fst_proj :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. A × B → A
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro p
  elim 3
  hyp
qed

theorem snd_proj :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. A × B → B
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro p
  elim 3
  hyp
qed

theorem pair_beta_fst :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ∀x:A. ∀y:B. Fst(<x, y>) = x ∈ A
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro x
  intro y
  auto
qed

theorem pair_beta_snd :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ∀x:A. ∀y:B. Snd(<x, y>) = y ∈ B
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro x
  intro y
  auto
qed

-- Product universal property: Fork
theorem fork_fst :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ∀C:U{i}. ∀f:(A → B). ∀g:(A → C). ∀x:A.
    Fst(Fork(f; g) x) = f x ∈ B
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro C
  intro f
  intro g
  intro x
  auto
qed

theorem fork_snd :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ∀C:U{i}. ∀f:(A → B). ∀g:(A → C). ∀x:A.
    Snd(Fork(f; g) x) = g x ∈ C
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro C
  intro f
  intro g
  intro x
  auto
qed

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Coproducts, injections, and universal property
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

theorem inl_intro :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. A → A ⊎ B
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro x
  left
  hyp
qed

theorem inr_intro :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. B → A ⊎ B
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro y
  right
  hyp
qed

theorem case_union :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ∀C:U{i}.
    (A → C) → (B → C) → A ⊎ B → C
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro C
  intro f
  intro g
  intro d
  elim 6 THENL [
    elim 4 with u THENL [hyp, hyp],
    elim 5 with v THENL [hyp, hyp]
  ]
qed

-- Coproduct universal property: Case
theorem case_inl :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ∀C:U{i}. ∀f:(A → C). ∀g:(B → C). ∀x:A.
    Case(f; g) (inl x) = f x ∈ C
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro C
  intro f
  intro g
  intro x
  auto
qed

theorem case_inr :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ∀C:U{i}. ∀f:(A → C). ∀g:(B → C). ∀y:B.
    Case(f; g) (inr y) = g y ∈ C
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro C
  intro f
  intro g
  intro y
  auto
qed

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Currying adjunction and roundtrip isomorphism
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

theorem curry :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ∀C:U{i}. (A × B → C) → A → B → C
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro C
  intro f
  intro x
  intro y
  elim 4 with <x, y> THENL [auto, hyp]
qed

theorem uncurry :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ∀C:U{i}. (A → B → C) → A × B → C
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro C
  intro f
  intro p
  elim 5
  elim 4 with u THENL [hyp, elim 8 with v THENL [hyp, hyp]]
qed

theorem curry_uncurry :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ∀C:U{i}. ∀f:(A → B → C). ∀x:A. ∀y:B.
    Curry(Uncurry(f)) x y = f x y ∈ C
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro C
  intro f
  intro x
  intro y
  auto
qed

theorem uncurry_curry :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ∀C:U{i}. ∀f:(A × B → C). ∀x:A. ∀y:B.
    Uncurry(Curry(f)) <x, y> = f <x, y> ∈ C
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro C
  intro f
  intro x
  intro y
  auto
qed

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Dependent types and universes
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

theorem sigma_intro :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:(A → U{i}). ∀a:A. B a → (x:A) × B x
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro a
  intro b
  intro with a THENL [hyp, hyp]
qed

theorem sigma_fst :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:(A → U{i}). ((x:A) × B x) → A
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro p
  elim 3
  hyp
qed

theorem dep_apply :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:(A → U{i}). ∀f:((x:A) → B x). ∀a:A. B a
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro f
  intro a
  elim 3 with a THENL [hyp, hyp]
qed

theorem cumulativity :
  ∀A:U{i}. A ∈ U{i+1}
proof
  intro A
  hyp
qed

theorem isect_id :
  ⋂A:U{i}. A → A
proof
  intro A
  intro x
  hyp
qed
